title: Real-Life: Swimming lesson cancellation
situation: Your seven-year-old son has a swimming lesson at Riverside Sports Center on Saturday morning. You call the center and hear the following recorded message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling Riverside Sports Center. The main pool will be closed this Saturday for emergency repairs, so all lessons scheduled for that day are cancelled. Regular lessons will resume next Saturday. Students who missed a lesson because of this closure may attend a make-up session on Sunday at 10 a.m. in the small pool. Please bring your membership card, as the session is open only to registered students. Parents who would rather have their fee returned can request a refund at the front desk on the first floor. We apologize for any inconvenience.
translation: リバーサイド・スポーツセンターにお電話いただきありがとうございます。緊急の修理のため、今週の土曜日はメインプールを閉鎖いたします。そのため、その日に予定されていたレッスンはすべて中止です。通常のレッスンは来週の土曜日から再開します。今回の閉鎖で受講できなかった生徒の方は、日曜日の午前10時から小プールで行う振替レッスンに参加できます。振替レッスンは登録会員のみを対象としていますので、会員カードをお持ちください。返金をご希望の保護者の方は、1階の受付で手続きができます。ご不便をおかけして申し訳ありません。

questions.question: What should you do if you want your son to make up the missed lesson?
choices: Ask for a refund at the front desk on the first floor.
Take your son to the main pool on Saturday afternoon.
Bring your son and your membership card to the small pool on Sunday morning.
Wait until next Saturday and attend the regular lesson.
questions.explanation: 土曜のレッスンは中止で、振替は日曜午前10時に小プールで行われる。振替には会員カードが必要。返金は振替を希望しない場合の手続きである。メインプールは土曜に閉鎖されているので、土曜午後に連れて行ってもレッスンは受けられない。来週土曜の通常レッスンは欠席分の振替にはならない。

title: Real-Life: Residence certificate deadline
situation: You need an English residence certificate for a visa application. The application must be submitted by Friday. Today is Tuesday, and you work until 6 p.m. on weekdays. You call Westbridge City Hall and hear the following recorded message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling Westbridge City Hall. The Citizen Services counter is open from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays. On Wednesdays, however, the counter stays open until 7 p.m. It is also open from 9 a.m. to noon on the second and fourth Saturdays of each month. You can receive an English residence certificate at the counter if you bring your passport and proof of address. You can also request one online, but it is mailed to your home and takes about five business days to arrive. If you need the document urgently, please visit the counter in person. Thank you for calling.
translation: ウェストブリッジ市役所にお電話いただきありがとうございます。市民サービス窓口は平日の午前8時30分から午後5時まで開いています。ただし水曜日は午後7時まで開いています。毎月第2・第4土曜日は午前9時から正午まで開いています。パスポートと住所を証明する書類をお持ちいただければ、窓口で英語版の居住証明書を発行できます。オンラインでも申し込めますが、ご自宅に郵送され、届くまでに約5営業日かかります。急ぎの場合は、窓口へ直接お越しください。お電話ありがとうございました。

questions.question: What is the best way to get the certificate in time?
choices: Request it online and wait for it to be mailed.
Visit the counter on Saturday morning.
Visit the counter on Wednesday evening after work.
Visit the counter on Tuesday evening after work.
questions.explanation: 査証の申請は金曜日までに必要。火曜日の窓口は午後5時に閉まるので、仕事が終わる6時では間に合わない。水曜日は7時まで開いているので、仕事帰りに行ける。郵送は約5営業日かかり、金曜に間に合わない。土曜の窓口は金曜の締め切りより後になる。

title: Real-Life: Campsite reservation change
situation: You booked a two-night stay at Pine Hollow Campground for this weekend. Your family is arriving on Friday at 3 p.m. It is now Thursday at 4 p.m., and you have just received the following message. Your family still wants to camp at Pine Hollow, but they can come only next weekend.
script: Narrator: This is Pine Hollow Campground with a message about your reservation for this weekend. Heavy rain is forecast for Saturday, and the lake will be closed for swimming and boating that day. You may change your dates to next weekend at no cost if you make the change by six p.m. today, as long as the new dates are available. After six p.m., changes are possible only with a fee of twenty percent of the total price. A cancellation is fully refunded only if it is made at least forty-eight hours before arrival. Guests who prefer a cabin to a tent may also switch to a cabin for a small extra fee.
translation: パイン・ホロウ・キャンプ場からのお知らせです。今週末のご予約についてご連絡します。土曜日は大雨の予報が出ており、その日は湖での水泳とボート遊びができません。新しい日程が空いていれば、本日午後6時までに変更していただくと無料で来週末に変更できます。午後6時以降の変更は、総額の20%の手数料がかかります。キャンセルは、到着の48時間以上前にされた場合にのみ全額返金されます。テントではなくコテージをご希望の方は、少額の追加料金で変更できます。

questions.question: What should you do to keep the campsite without paying a fee?
choices: Change the dates to next weekend before six p.m. today.
Cancel the booking and receive a full refund.
Change the dates to next weekend after six p.m. today.
Keep this weekend's booking and switch to a cabin.
questions.explanation: 家族は来週末しか来られず、この週末は使えない。日程変更は本日18時までなら無料(空きがある場合)で、現在は木曜16時なので間に合う。18時以降は20%の手数料がかかる。全額返金のキャンセルは到着の48時間前までで、金曜15時到着なので水曜15時が期限だったため、既に過ぎている。この週末のまま小屋に変えても、来られない日程なので意味がない。

title: Real-Life: Dog boarding pick-up
situation: You left your dog at Happy Paws Pet Hotel while you were on a business trip. You are at home now and want the staff to bring your dog home. You call the pet hotel and hear the following recorded message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling Happy Paws Pet Hotel. Dogs can be picked up at our front desk every day from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Please bring the receipt you received when you dropped your dog off, and pay the remaining fee at the desk. If you would rather not come to the hotel, our staff can bring your dog to your home for a small extra charge. Please book this delivery service at least one day in advance. Our staff will call you before they leave. Thank you for choosing Happy Paws.
translation: ハッピー・パウズ・ペットホテルにお電話いただきありがとうございます。わんちゃんのお引き取りは、毎日午前9時から午後6時まで受付でお受けしております。預けた時にお渡しした領収書をお持ちのうえ、残りの料金を受付でお支払いください。ホテルまでお越しいただくのが難しい場合は、少額の追加料金でスタッフがご自宅までお届けすることもできます。この配達サービスは、少なくとも1日前までにご予約ください。スタッフは出発する前にお電話いたします。ハッピー・パウズをご利用いただきありがとうございます。

questions.question: What should you do to have your dog delivered to your home?
choices: Bring your receipt to the front desk before 6 p.m.
Pick up your dog at the front desk after 6 p.m.
Ask the staff to bring your dog home today.
Book the delivery service at least one day in advance.
questions.explanation: 自宅への配達は、少なくとも1日前に予約するのが条件。受付での引き取りは午後6時までで、領収書を持って行くが、これは配達ではない。午後6時以降は受付が閉まっている。当日の依頼は1日前の予約という条件に合わないので頼めない。

title: Real-Life: Lost parking ticket
situation: You drove to Central Plaza and parked in the underground garage. Earlier today you bought a sweater for 4,000 yen at a shop in the plaza. You have the receipt in your bag, but you cannot find your parking ticket. At the exit gate, you hear the following message from the intercom.
script: Narrator: Welcome to Central Plaza Parking. If you have lost your parking ticket, you will be charged the maximum daily fee of 2,000 yen. However, customers who have a receipt from a shop in the plaza can receive a discount of 1,000 yen off that fee. The receipt must be dated today and must show a purchase of at least 3,000 yen. Please show your receipt to the staff in the exit booth, and they will calculate your fee. Card and cash payments are both accepted. Thank you for parking with us.
translation: セントラル・プラザ駐車場へようこそ。駐車券をなくされた場合は、1日の最大料金である2,000円をお支払いいただきます。ただし、館内の店舗で領収書をお持ちのお客様は、その料金から1,000円の割引を受けられます。領収書の日付は本日のもので、3,000円以上のお買い物の記載が必要です。出口の精算ブースで領収書をスタッフにお見せください。料金を計算いたします。カードでも現金でもお支払いいただけます。ご利用ありがとうございます。

questions.question: How much will you have to pay to leave the garage?
questions.explanation: 駐車券をなくすと最大料金の2,000円。本日付で3,000円以上の買い物の領収書があれば1,000円割引される。4,000円のセーターなので条件を満たし、2,000円から1,000円を引いて1,000円を払う。2,000円は割引を使わない場合の料金。

title: Real-Life: Race bib collection
situation: You entered the Lakeside Half Marathon, but you will be on a business trip on Saturday. Your friend Mika has agreed to collect your bib, but she has already agreed to collect bibs for two other runners. You will return home on Sunday at 6 a.m., and the race starts at 8 a.m. You call the event office and hear the following recorded message.
script: Narrator: This is an announcement from the Lakeside Half Marathon. Race bibs can be collected at the Expo Hall on Saturday from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. Runners must show a photo ID. Anyone who cannot collect a bib in person may send a representative, but each representative may collect bibs for no more than two runners. Bibs that have not been collected by 5 p.m. on Saturday will be given out on race morning only, at the start area. Please note that bib collection at the start area closes at 7 a.m., and runners who arrive after that will not receive a bib. Thank you, and good luck.
translation: レイクサイド・ハーフマラソン事務局からのお知らせです。ゼッケンは土曜日の午前10時から午後5時まで、エキスポ会場で受け取れます。ランナー本人は写真付きの身分証を提示してください。本人が受け取れない場合は代理人を立てることができますが、代理人が受け取れるのは最大2人のランナー分までです。土曜日の午後5時までに受け取られなかったゼッケンは、当日の朝にスタート会場でのみお渡しします。スタート会場での受け取りは午前7時に締め切られますので、それ以降に到着された方はゼッケンを受け取れません。よい結果を願っています。

questions.question: What should you do to get your bib?
choices: Ask Mika to collect the bib on Saturday.
Collect the bib at the start area on race morning before 7 a.m.
Collect the bib at the Expo Hall on Sunday at 9 a.m.
Collect the bib at the start area on Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 友人は既に2人分の代理を引き受けているため、もう代理人にはなれない。土曜に受け取れないと、土曜午後5時以降は当日朝にスタート会場で配られる。日曜6時に帰宅しても、スタート会場の受け取りは7時まで間に合う。エキスポ会場は土曜だけで、日曜には開いていない。スタート会場で配るのは当日朝だけなので、土曜午後に受け取ることはできない。

title: Real-Life: Sofa delivery
situation: You ordered a sofa that will be delivered on Thursday between 8 a.m. and noon. You work from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Thursday, so you will be away from home all day. You live in an apartment building with a concierge desk. You call Oakwood Furniture and hear the following recorded message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling Oakwood Furniture Delivery. Your sofa is scheduled to arrive on Thursday between 8 a.m. and noon. Our driver will call you thirty minutes before arrival. If you cannot receive the delivery, you can change the date at no cost, as long as you call at least two days in advance. Changes made on the day of delivery cost a fee of 3,000 yen. If no one is home when the driver arrives, the sofa can be left with the building concierge at no extra charge, but only if you have given written permission in advance. Thank you for choosing Oakwood.
translation: オークウッド家具配送センターにお電話いただきありがとうございます。ご注文のソファは木曜日の午前8時から正午の間にお届け予定です。配達員は到着の30分前にお電話いたします。お受け取りが難しい場合は、少なくとも2日前までにお電話いただければ、無料で日付を変更できます。配達当日の変更は3,000円の手数料がかかります。配達員が到着した時にご在宅でない場合は、建物のコンシェルジュに追加料金なしでお預けすることもできます。ただし、事前に書面でご許可をいただいた場合に限ります。オークウッドをご利用いただきありがとうございます。

questions.question: What should you do so that the sofa is delivered without any fee?
choices: Give the building concierge written permission in advance.
Call the company on Thursday morning to change the delivery.
Call the company the day before to change the date.
Wait at home until the driver calls thirty minutes before.
questions.explanation: 木曜は一日中不在なので、在宅しなくても受け取れる方法が必要。管理人に預けるには事前の書面での許可が必要で、手数料もかからない。配達当日の変更は3,000円かかる。前日の変更は無料の条件(2日前まで)を満たさない。在宅で待つのは不在の日には不可能。
